sources.title: The truth behind Chrome's 4GB 'weights.bin' Gemini Nano file

sources.title: Chrome quietly installed 4GB of AI files on my PC — here's how to ...
sources.snippet: To re-download the Gemini Nano model, or the weights.bin file, simply re-enable the On-device AI setting. The download may take some time, depending on how fast your internet speed is.
